provenance.scope: Recorded coordinated-editor imports and source validation, followed by offline checks of the current working-tree files. No Unreal process was launched by this curator.
provenance.revision_note: Working-tree source/import evidence; this does not assert an exact committed source, a fresh build, or a packaged release.

source_authorship.weapon_inventory_attestation: Original Project ONE geometry and authored rig actions. C04 refines Project ONE grip/fore-end interfaces; no third-party asset, texture, animation or recording input.
source_authorship.machine_inventory_attestation: Original procedural Project ONE machine geometry; no third-party asset inputs.
source_authorship.machine_audio_inventory_attestation: Original deterministic synthesis, no external samples or assets.
source_authorship.coordinate_convention: Centimetres, +X barrel, +Z up. Every assembled static part shares the grip origin. Legacy FBX import reflects source Y; offsets below are already UE coordinates.

source_validation.historical_status_note: The inventory retains its pre-import authoring status. The later WeaponAssetImport record separately reports successful import of all 15 static parts and 12 clips; the earlier status has not been relabeled.

metadata_validation_recorded.scope: Metadata sanitizer compares FBX semantic properties, PNG non-text chunks and Blender bytes outside verified metadata fields; no runtime import claim

source_validation.machine_source_scope: Blender FBX roundtrip dimensions/pivots, triangle counts, material slots, vertex colors and source assembly keyframe poses. Unreal/runtime appearance and sounds are separate checks.
source_validation.visual_scope_note: Finite transforms, unchanged sampled lower-body bases, dimensions, pivots, and source magazine-seat calculations are numerical/source checks. They do not certify in-game hand contact, motion quality, model readability, or machine appearance.

weapons.scope: Only inventory-listed original weapon assets and upper-body clips

import_validation_recorded.source_hash_semantics: Import reports hash the authored input bytes. These are not hashes of imported package bytes or an independent current Unreal AssetImportData readback.

placement_validation_recorded.verification_method: The full-editor placement script compared all 96 existing non-machine actor identities and nine numeric transform components before/after placement; each transform difference had to remain below 0.0001. It added two blocking machine actors, waited for navigation build completion, then saved the map.
placement_validation_recorded.scope_limit: Actor identity/transform preservation is not bytewise preservation of all serialized actor/component properties. Navigation-build completion is not a claim that every gameplay route has been visually or physically traversed.

offline_verification.package_hash_scope: The 82 imported package hashes and map hash are a current offline file snapshot. The original import/placement reports supplied no imported-package/map hashes for historical comparison; existence/current hashes do not independently revalidate current Unreal object internals.

separate_review_scopes.visual_review: Not approved by this report. Actual gameplay-frame review is separate, including native-scale hand/shell readability and machine highlight/HUD limitations.
separate_review_scopes.audio_review: Machine audio import duration/format/loop settings are separate from perceptual audition. No timbre or mix approval is asserted; perceptual audition remains unavailable.
separate_review_scopes.runtime_and_release: Functional tests, manual input, performance, fresh builds and packaging are separate gates, not inferred from import PASS.
